tool: Blender 5.2.1 procedural bpy; FBX path_mode=STRIP, material slots only, no embedded/linked textures; tex/*.png basecolors shipped separately
collision_check: find <studio>/art -name 'prop-*.fbx' run 2026-10-28; all four names free (prop-raising-stake-ar1 keeps required suffix). Nearby existing: prop-stake-anvil-small, prop-thimble-stake, prop-raising-hammer-cs1 - different names/shapes.
judgment_calls: Breastplate stands upright on lower edge (clearest silhouette) with medial ridge bulge.
Spaulder v1 half-dome read as thin arc on sheet; rebuilt as full low oval cupped lame (140 tris, >120 pref, <210 max). Low elongated cup, not skull-tall, to stay distinct from prop-skull-blank.
Raising stake: short oak stump + broad flat planishing face + side raising horn, total 0.43 m, stouter than prop-rivet-anvil-hm1.
